    "content_marketing": {"S2": 12500},

    "referral_program": {"S2": 500},
})

r_dev = nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 1500})
# Re-assert global ops/dev
r_daily = nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=1600, development=300)

print("PRICE:", r_price)
print("PROMO:", r_promo)

print("OPS:", r_ops)
